name: mirage
text: Crashing is serious, so I'm on it first. Likely memory: with Kalshi on, the phone holds Kalshi's whole 14,000-market board plus its live socket, and the Arb/feed screens re-read it. I'm checking what the phone holds in memory with Kalshi on, and whether a crash report reached GitHub. If you can, open Settings > Diagnostics and send me the report right after a crash; it names who holds the memory.
